WITH RECURSIVE call_chain AS (
  -- Start from all direct callers of Client._send_single_request within httpx/_client.py
  SELECT caller_symbol_id
  FROM code.call_edges
  WHERE callee_symbol_id = 'Client._send_single_request'
    AND caller_file_id IN (
      SELECT file_id FROM code.files WHERE file_name = '_client.py' AND package = 'httpx'
    )
    AND passes_as_callback = FALSE
  UNION ALL
  -- Recursively follow direct calls within the same file
  SELECT ce.caller_symbol_id
  FROM code.call_edges ce
  JOIN call_chain cc ON ce.callee_symbol_id = cc.caller_symbol_id
  WHERE ce.caller_file_id IN (
      SELECT file_id FROM code.files WHERE file_name = '_client.py' AND package = 'httpx'
    )
    AND ce.passes_as_callback = FALSE
    AND ce.caller_symbol_id != 'Client._send_single_request'
)
SELECT DISTINCT caller_symbol_id
FROM call_chain
WHERE caller_symbol_id != 'Client._send_single_request';

Within httpx/_client.py, which functions or methods eventually lead to a call of `Client._send_single_request`, through a chain of one or more direct calls whose every step is inside httpx/_client.py? Count direct calls only (no callbacks) and exclude `_send_single_request` itself. Give their symbol IDs.

  SELECT ce.caller_symbol_id
  FROM code.call_edges ce
  JOIN call_chain cc ON ce.callee_symbol_id = cc.caller_symbol_id
  JOIN code.files f2 ON f2.file_id = ce.caller_file_id
  WHERE f2.module = '_client'
    AND ce.passes_as_callback = FALSE
    AND ce.caller_symbol_id != 'Client._send_single_request'
)
SELECT DISTINCT caller_symbol_id

WHERE caller_symbol_id != 'Client._send_single_request';
